messages:
Sam: Quick recap from marketplace procurement: they want guidance on commit escrow, credit shelf-life, and a clawback policy for repeat underutilizers. Can we land a simple rule set?
Priya: Yes. High level: (1) escrowed smoothing credits vest monthly over 6mo, (2) unused credits expire after 12 months unless customer opts into remediation, (3) repeat underutilization triggers a clawback guard that steps down discounts.
Gabe: Recommend exact triggers: first-term underutilization -> remediation options (3mo extension OR apply up to 40% vested credits to next term). If underutilized again in the next term (<65% trailing 3mo) -> discount steps down by 3% and RevOps review required.
Lina: Marketplace UX note: show "credit expiry" date on the private-offer attachment. Procurement likes a hard date. Also add a "credit escrow" line item so credits are visible in billing.
Sam: Draft example to show procurement (compact):
```
Commit = $400k/yr
Band discount = 14% -> discounted commit = $344k
Smoothing credit escrow = $20k, vest $3.33k/mo over 6mo
If trailing 3mo avg usage < 70% -> customer elects remediation: 3mo extension OR apply up to 40% of remaining vested credits to next term
Credit expiry = 12 months from grant unless remediation accepted (then expiry extends to remediation end)
Repeat underutilization (2x terms) -> discount step-down 3% unless CRO approves
```
Priya: Legal will push on "clawback" wording. Phrase as "discount adjustment" and require CRO approval for exceptions. Also require remediation plan signed by both parties to unlock any applied credits.
Gabe: Ops: add meter_id mapping and a private_offer_tag so RevOps can query events. Reconciliation CSV delivered within 7 business days of month-end; disputes within 45 days. If meter divergence > 3% in first billing cycle, pause credit vesting until resolved.
Lina: For hardware partners: if appliance SKU included, appliance surcharge is separate and does not reduce commitable spend. Call it out explicitly to avoid confusion.
Sam: Announcement cadence: do not publish pricing until partner assets + SI onboarding checklist live. Suggested: partner announcement 7 days post-close, marketplace listing 14 days post-close.
Priya: Add non-stacking default: private-offer credits do not stack with public promos. Co-marketing payouts are separate and require explicit callout in private-offer attachment to stack.
Gabe: Finance note: escrowed smoothing credits are treated as deferred revenue reductions; co-sell payouts are partner expenses. We'll include a 1-line accounting note in the playbook.
Lina: UX: keep SKU short: "Redwood Commit (PrivOffer) - 1Y - Band X" and include a 1-pager PDF with escrow math, expiry, meter IDs, and contact matrix.
partner-bot: Task created: escrow-clawback-playbook -> owner: Sam, due_in: 3 business days (id: PE-4512).
Sam: I'll draft the 1-pager + three calc scenarios (fast ramp / slow ramp / appliance) and circulate for Legal/RevOps wordsmithing. Thanks all.
